course_name_original: Ingeniería De La Calidad Y Del Mantenimiento

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and skills to apply the scientific and technological foundations of quality and maintenance engineering.

syllabus_topics: Terminology, Standards and Control Ratios in Maintenance

assessment_methods.method: Continuous Assessment Test 1 (PEC Primera Unidad Didáctica I)
Continuous Assessment Test 2 (PEC Segunda Unidad Didáctica II)

assessment_rules: A minimum mark of 5 out of 10 in the final exam is required to sum the continuous assessment (PEC) grade. The final grade is the weighted sum of the final exam (70%) and the continuous assessment (30%) within the same call. There are two calls for the final exam (ordinary in June, extraordinary in September). To be evaluated in a call, the student must take the final exam for that call.
